AuditKind.doc: The kind of occurrence an AuditEvent records (spec section 18).

Controller.doc: The *role* a controller plays for a group, not its ROS node name.

Frame.doc: The three frame aliases the agent resolves against the profile.

GroupKind.doc: What a joint group is for, which decides what it is allowed to do.

Locomotion.doc: The base's drive type. Gates what teleop accepts: ``lateral`` velocity needs OMNI.

Phase.doc: Progress state of a motion, shared by NavStatus and TrajStatus.

SlamMode.doc: slam_toolbox's mode. Switched at service level, never by restarting the process (see the nav restructure).

Transport.doc: How array bytes reach the client.

action.invoke.doc: Invoke a validated profile action. Returns an explicit unverified dispatch receipt; topic/payload details are integration diagnostics.

arm.joint_states.doc: Controller-level joint state of one arm (pre-MoveIt). Limits parsed from /robot_description (null for continuous joints / before the description arrives).

params.stamp: optional float ROS seconds; select a recorded snapshot

result.positions: optional {joint: position}, measured robot snapshot when include_external=true
result.stamp: optional float ROS seconds | null, common timestamp of snapshot

arm.wrench.doc: Latest force/torque reading of one arm's wrist sensor (profile force_torque.<arm>.topic).

audit.query.doc: Query the agent's in-memory audit ring buffer. All filters optional; newest events last.

audit.subscribe.doc: Start receiving audit.event notifications on this connection.

camera.deproject.doc: Pixel -> 3D point using the depth + TF snapshotted with THAT frame (FrameExpired past frame_ttl). in_frame must be the camera frame or a capture-time snapshot (@map/@odom/@base).

camera.get_cloud.doc: Voxel-downsampled point cloud from the latest depth (+rgb colors when aligned). voxel is mandatory: it is the size budget of the call.

camera.get_depth.doc: Latest depth frame, float32 meters, via PayloadRef.

camera.get_frame.doc: Latest RGB frame as a PayloadRef (raw pixels over shared memory in v1 — local execution; compressed transports are a future PayloadRef.transport). frame_id stays valid for deprojection for frame_ttl seconds.

camera.get_synced.doc: RGB-D pair with closest stamps (within the agent's sync tolerance); both halves share one frame_id.

camera.info.doc: Camera metadata: intrinsics (null without a camera_info topic), depth availability, frame_ttl, TF frame.

camera.stream_start.doc: Start a server-pushed frame stream (stream.data notifications). fps is clamped to the profile's max_stream_fps.

camera.stream_stop.doc: Stop a frame stream started by this client.

commands.get.doc: Query retained acceptance without replaying a mutating request. Mutations carry top-level command_id (epoch.expiry_milliseconds.uuid).

debug.run_task.doc: Test-only: a cancellable timer task emitting progress updates. Exercises the task lifecycle until real long-running verbs exist.

debug.send_payload.doc: Test-only: agent sends a random binary payload of the requested size, returns its id and sha256. Exercises the binary channel until real image methods exist (Phase 4).

debug.set_estop.doc: Simulated e-stop toggle (for profiles with no hardware e-stop topic). Engaged e-stop rejects all motion methods with SafetyViolation(reason='estop').

events.subscribe.doc: Start receiving event notifications (estop changes, watch fires) on this connection.

group.control_start.doc: Acquire counted control authority; controller changes are serialized and unwound on failure.

group.control_stop.doc: Cancel this group's work, restore controllers with readback, and release only this acquisition. Cleanup failure quarantines motion.

group.hold.doc: Command fresh finite measured positions in a current session. Reject while a trajectory occupies the adapter.

group.start_tool.doc: Accept verified positioning work; physical contact/holding is separate.

group.start_trajectory.doc: Submit a model-bound trajectory; task updates carry verified endpoint/stopping evidence.

group.stop.doc: Cancel only this group's accepted tasks; returns dispatch count, not verified physical-rest evidence.

group.tool_state.doc: Read measured tool state and holding inference.

guard.open.doc: Owner-scoped persistent guard; initial fresh safe evaluation precedes acceptance.

guard.remove.doc: Stop/drain before removing only this guard inhibit.

guard.reset.doc: Reset after verified cleanup and fresh safe evaluation; never resumes old work.

hello.doc: Handshake. Must be the first call on a connection.

lease.renew.doc: Renew this connection's finite authority; never refreshes drive intent.

lidar.scan.doc: Latest 2D sweep; ranges travel as a PayloadRef (float32 meters).

lidar.stream_start.doc: Start a server-pushed scan stream (stream.data notifications). hz is server-clamped.

lidar.stream_stop.doc: Stop a scan stream started by this client.

measurement.get.doc: Read a bounded fresh pose/joint observation with source/receive provenance.

mobility.get_state.doc: Pose (map frame when localized, else odom — pose.frame says which), velocity, is_moving, distance_traveled.

mobility.navigate_to.doc: Navigate to a goal via Nav2 (task). goal is a Pose or {place: name} (spec 17 sugar). The agent clears both costmaps first. task.update notifications carry feedback in data (distance_remaining, pose, ...). Failure: NavigationFailed with reason no_path|stuck|aborted.

mobility.start_route.doc: Accept a finite framed route with measured arrival at every endpoint.

mobility.stop.doc: Immediate halt: cancels running mobility tasks + the active Nav2 goal, zeroes velocity. No resume (Q3).

operations.get.doc: Query retained terminal evidence or explicit unknown outcome after restart; authenticated principal ownership is required across connections.

payload.set_transport.doc: Select the connection-local array transport advertised by welcome.

ping.doc: Round-trip check; returns an empty object.

places.delete.doc: Delete a named place from the active map (UnknownPlace if absent).

places.get.doc: A named place's Pose on the active map (UnknownPlace if absent — including places saved on OTHER maps).

places.list.doc: Place names on the active map.

places.save.doc: Save a named place on the active map; pose defaults to the robot's current pose. Persists alongside the map files (places.yaml, human-editable).

range.read.doc: Latest reading of one single-beam ranger (profile range_sensors.<name>).

signal.get.doc: Read a discovered signal with explicit source/receive freshness.

slam.delete.doc: Delete a saved map (refuses the active one).

slam.get_map.doc: The current occupancy grid; data travels as a PayloadRef ((H,W) int8, ROS convention: -1 unknown, 0 free, 100 occupied).

slam.load.doc: Load a saved map's pose graph and continue mapping on top of it.

slam.localize.doc: Switch to localization mode against a saved map (default: the active one) at the given pose (default: current estimate).

slam.relocalize.doc: Re-run localization at the current pose estimate (the is_lost recovery path).

slam.save.doc: Serialize the pose graph + export the 2D grid + write MapInfo under map_dir/<name>/. Scratch-map places migrate to the named map.

slam.start.doc: Ensure mapping mode: unpause from idle, or reset to a fresh map from localization (modes are service-level, never process restarts). Set preserve_graph to resume the loaded graph without clearing it.

slam.stop.doc: Pause map building (idle); map + TF stay published.

slam.wait_for_localization.doc: Block until localization quality is healthy; TimeoutError otherwise.

status.get.doc: Battery (null without a battery topic) and e-stop state.

task.cancel.doc: Owner-only cancellation. Terminal cancellation is idempotent; unknown or expired IDs fail.

task.status.doc: Owner-only authoritative state, retained after completion for the handshake's advertised window.

teleop.drive.doc: One velocity command, clamped by profile limits. Must recur within the watchdog period or the agent halts the robot. lateral needs omni locomotion.

teleop.end.doc: Zero velocity, stop the watchdog, release the motion lock.

teleop.start.doc: Acquire the motion lock and start a teleop session. Watchdog is clamped to the profile's max_watchdog.

teleop.stop.doc: Immediate zero velocity; the session stays alive.

tf.frames.doc: All frame names currently in the TF tree.

tf.lookup.doc: Latest transform that re-expresses child-frame coordinates in the parent frame. @map/@odom/@base aliases resolve against the profile.

params.stamp: optional float ROS seconds; omit for latest

tf.transform.doc: Re-express a Pose or Point in another frame.

tf.wait_for.doc: Block until a frame exists in TF; TimeoutError otherwise.

watch.poll.doc: Read a watch's latched state (owner only).

result.triggered_at: float|null, wall stamp of first fire

watch.start.doc: Arm a bridge-side condition monitor over a dotted state path. Exactly one of above/below/outside. stop=true halts all motion when it fires (teleop sessions ended, tasks cancelled, zero twist), audit-logged, and survives owner disconnect for `lifetime` seconds.

params.debounce: float s the condition must hold, default 0

watch.stop.doc: Disarm and remove a watch (owner only).

AuditKind.title: AuditKind

Outcome.description:
How an audited call ended.

REJECTED is the safety layer refusing before the handler ran; ERROR is
the handler (or a task body) failing; CANCELLED is a running task
stopped on request.

CANCELLED is a fourth member beyond the three in spec section 27
(decision 18, 2026-08-24). The audit log is the safety record, and it
has to distinguish "the operator stopped it" from "it broke" —
collapsing a cancellation into ERROR would make the log lie about the
one thing it exists to answer. The free text that used to be stuffed
in here ("error: <msg>", "failed: <msg>") moved to ``detail``, which
is where the model always said it belonged.
Outcome.title: Outcome

AuditEvent.description:
One audited occurrence on the agent.

``stamp`` is ISO 8601 UTC. ``client`` is the connection id that caused
the event (None for agent-internal events). ``call`` is the wire method
plus its params with binary payloads elided. ``outcome`` carries the
reason in ``detail``.
AuditEvent.title: AuditEvent

Everything here is profile config plus the joint list the agent
resolved off the controller at startup. It is in the handshake and not
behind a call because kinematics is client-side (spec 26.2): a mission
doing `kin.reachable()` in a loop must not pay a round trip per solve,
and it cannot solve at all without knowing the tip and the joint order.

Transport.description:
How array bytes reach the client.

SHM maps local Linux /dev/shm read-only. NET sends raw numeric arrays in
tagged binary WebSocket frames, independently of JSON-RPC command objects.
New TCP clients negotiate NET; Unix clients default to SHM. Both can select
explicitly with Robot(..., transport=Transport.NET or Transport.SHM).
